description: EDOVAW crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group C 2/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C80 H112 Lu4 N4 O4 Si4,2(C4 H8 O1). From the CIF bond table, Lu1 (Lu) has 2 O neighbors; Lu2 (Lu) has 2 O neighbors; Lu1A (Lu) has 2 O neighbors; Lu2A (Lu) has 2 O neighbors. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.627-3.769 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 104.59-108.87°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links.
